# Nvwa source notice

This copy derives from Humentity commit `286d33124648501535655a0de811cef55152b9fd` by Emberlight Studios. Original upstream notice `LICENSE` is unchanged. It offers MIT or Apache-2.0. Complete Apache-2.0 text is also retained under `licenses/Apache-2.0.txt`.

Nvwa changes retained in this source: CPU-focused package features and disabled physics; target squared-delta threshold zero; explicit typed target loading; zero padding of unused skin influences; read-only rig endpoint/roll frame and original weight access; public proxy vertex map. The geometric algorithms match the admitted frozen source cohort. Production registration now adds precise resource-existence guards for the readiness check and reset observer before lazy B1 resources are inserted. This scheduling-only change is retained as `production-lazy-resource-scheduling.patch`; the frozen baseline and current production hash maps are separate in `NVWA-PROVENANCE.json`. The package manifest additionally removes machine paths and its nested workspace and adds declared upstream license/repository metadata. `NVWA-PROVENANCE.json` binds original and current file identities and the admitted patch identities.

The optional GPU and physics source modules remain part of this small source cohort. Their presence does not enable physics or establish quality of the four-influence render route. Product B1 admission uses the positive-final-aggregate full CPU adapter and approved same sample only.

No Blender/MPFB program logic, downloaded character examples, generated posed mesh arrays or reference matrices are included here. This bounded source integration does not resolve the application's separate release notices, first-party licensing, signing or distribution gates.
